content: Pointer Events (pointerdown/move/up/cancel) are now supported across Chrome, Safari (iOS+macOS), Firefox, Edge with no polyfill needed. They unify mouse/touch/pen into one event model, eliminate the historic 300ms tap delay, and are the 2026 industry-standard choice over separate Touch Events for custom gesture handling. The existing prototype gestures.js already uses pointer events exclusively, confirming this is correct.
